## Baker Hughes and TPAO Explore Industrializing Next-generation Geothermal in Türkiye for Always-on Power Generation


11/12/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 1.03 MB](https://s21.q4cdn.com/548121662/files/doc_news/Baker-Hughes-and-TPAO-Explore-Industrializing-Next-generation-Geothermal-inTrkiye-for-Always-on-Power-Generation-2026.pdf)


- *Agreement includes roadmap for evaluating and developing next-generation enhanced geothermal systems (EGS) nationwide*
- *Supports Türkiye’s dual ambitions to reduce emissions and strengthen domestic energy security*


ANTALYA, Türkiye, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Baker Hughes (NASDAQ: BKR), an energy technology company, and Türkiye Petrolleri Anonim Ortaklığı (TPAO) announced Thursday an agreement to explore opportunities for enhanced geothermal systems (EGS), supporting Türkiye’s ambitions to scale lower carbon geothermal power generation and strengthen energy security. The agreement was signed during COP 31, the United Nations’ flagship climate conference, which is taking place this week in Antalya, Türkiye.


The agreement outlines a phased approach for industrializing next-generation geothermal development, which includes a country-wide assessment to evaluate EGS potential using data from TPAO and the General Directorate of Mineral Research and Exploration (MTA). Following this phase, Baker Hughes will support further derisking of the assets through evaluation of well locations and designs to assess their viability, followed by pilot drilling and, ultimately, commercial-scale EGS development.


“COP31 is an opportunity to move the conversation from ambition to action and demonstrate how our solutions can help deliver the reliable, lower-carbon energy our world needs,” said Baker Hughes Chairman and CEO Lorenzo Simonelli. “Enhanced geothermal systems have the potential to expand where geothermal energy can be developed, and our agreement with TPAO brings together the data, expertise and technology needed to advance that opportunity and unlock a new source of reliable, lower-carbon power that helps secure Türkiye’s future energy supply.”


With some of the world’s most favorable geologic conditions for geothermal, Türkiye ranks as Europe’s largest geothermal power producer and fourth globally, with installed capacity of approximately 1.8 gigawatts (GW). Today, its geothermal power comes from conventional resources. EGS could unlock new locations for development, helping Türkiye scale geothermal power and enable projects that deliver more reliable, baseload power to the grid.


Unlike conventional geothermal, which relies on naturally occurring water and steam reservoirs, EGS uses advanced technologies and water injection to create geothermal reservoir conditions in hot, dry rock deep underground, producing steam for power generation.


Baker Hughes is committed to advancing next-generation geothermal technologies, bringing together capabilities across subsurface evaluation, drilling, completions, power generation and digital.

**About TPAO**
As Türkiye’s national oil company, Türkiye Petrolleri Anonim Ortaklığı (TPAO) has been conducting oil and natural gas exploration and production activities for over 70 years. With strong technical capabilities, extensive experience, and a skilled workforce, TPAO operates both onshore and offshore. With Türkiye at the heart of its operations, TPAO is active in 10 countries across three continents, from Russia to Somalia and Hungary to Iraq, contributing to Türkiye’s energy independence.
